tests.title: Course timetable shows availability and no-session states
tests.goal: The enrolment calendar displays the selected timetable session availability.
preconditions: An active timetable with at least one scheduled date is available in staging.
data: Active timetable and scheduled date selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Courses & Enrolment > Enrolment Status.
Select an active timetable and navigate to a date with scheduled sessions.
Review session availability indicators for Free, Have Vacancies, Full, and No sessions where present.

expected.text: The selected timetable and date are reflected in the calendar.
Scheduled sessions show their availability state; dates without sessions show No sessions or no booking entry.
No enrolment or customer record is created.
